question: Should OpenClaw accept selectable quick-fix and full-change PR templates as the permanent contributor PR-authoring workflow?
rationale: The patch is mechanically sound, but it changes the repository’s contributor contract and how much context small external PRs are prompted to provide, so automation should not decide the policy alone.

options.title: Accept after current-head proof
options.body: Land this template split once the final rendered quick/full templates are proven or a maintainer explicitly accepts the source-level proof.

options.title: Keep one fallback template
options.body: Reject the split and continue using one canonical PR template for all contributor changes.

options.title: Narrow the quick template first
options.body: Require extra quick-template fields or CONTRIBUTING updates before accepting the new authoring path.

recommendation.title: Accept after current-head proof
recommendation.body: Land this template split once the final rendered quick/full templates are proven or a maintainer explicitly accepts the source-level proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Takhoffman has the strongest merged history on the PR template guidance this change modifies.
